_doc: Meta (persistent) currencies. Read by Progression. color is an HTML hex string; icon is a short glyph for UI.

currencies.name: Souls
currencies.description: Wrung from every slain angel and every coin of tithe. Spent on flesh and fury.

currencies.name: Sin Shards
currencies.description: Crystallised transgression, shed by elites and by long survival. Buys pacts, demons and favours.

currencies.name: Hellstone
currencies.description: Molten heart-rock torn from fallen archangels. Rare; tempers the finest weapons.
